result.instructions: Tools for Steady, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many paying members does my publication have, and what is the monthly income?"; "Which membership plans are published, and what does each one cost?"; "Is alice@example.com a current subscriber, and when does her subscription expire?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Steady data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run steady_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run steady_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run steady_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. steady_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: steady_get_publication
tools.title: Get publication
tools.description: Get the publication the API key belongs to: title, Steady page URL, member counts (paying, trial, free, guest, external), monthly income and whether it is public. Good first call. Steady API: GET /publication.

tools.name: steady_list_plans
tools.title: List membership plans
tools.description: List the publication's membership plans with state (draft, published, archived), currency, monthly and annual amounts, benefits and whether the plan is hidden. Steady API: GET /plans.

tools.name: steady_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List active subscriptions
tools.description: List the current subscriptions (in_trial, active, not_renewing, guest, external and their terminated states): state, period (monthly or annual), amounts, currency, expiry and the subscriber and plan. Contains personal data. Steady API: GET /subscriptions.

emails.description: Only subscribers with these email addresses (1-50). Omit to list all. Personal data.

tools.name: steady_list_inactive_subscriptions
tools.title: List ended subscriptions
tools.description: List the ended subscriptions (cancelled and expired, with cancelled-at and expires-at) with the subscriber and plan. Contains personal data. Steady API: GET /subscriptions/inactive.

emails.description: Only subscribers with these email addresses (1-50). Omit to list all. Personal data.

tools.name: steady_list_newsletter_subscribers
tools.title: List newsletter subscribers
tools.description: List the newsletter subscribers (email and the time they confirmed the opt-in). Contains personal data. Steady API: GET /newsletter_subscribers.
